lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the garden in the moonlight,
Your hand in mine feels like a velvet dream,
The stars are dancing in the velvet night,
Everything is peaceful, just as it seems.
[Chorus]
You are the melody my heart keeps playing,
My steady anchor in the shifting tide,
With every word your spirit is portraying,
I find the place where my secrets hide.
[Verse]
The streetlamps glow like pearls on the lane,
Your laughter is the music in the air,
I find my shelter in the falling rain,
I find my comfort in the love we share.
[Chorus]
You are the melody my heart keeps playing,
My steady anchor in the shifting tide,
With every word your spirit is portraying,
I find the place where my secrets hide.
[Bridge]
The world may spin and shadows might grow,
But your love is the only truth I know.
[Chorus]
You are the melody my heart keeps playing,
My steady anchor in the shifting tide,
With every word your spirit is portraying,
I find the place where my secrets hide.
[Outro]
